title: Learning reminder availability notification policy
description: Additive policy layered over course-progress-data.json. Visibility (isToDisplay) is necessary but not sufficient for a notification -- this file is the explicit signal for whether a category, or a category-4/class-0 activity, is notification-worthy. Never infer this from a category number alone.

categoryPolicies.description: Category-level policy for the already-included categories 1 and 2. Present to make the existing behavior explicit rather than assumed.

categoryClassZeroPolicies.description: Per-theme opt-in for the category-4/class-0 identity. Matches Notification.get_course_progress_availability_recipients's rule: classNumber '0' is accepted only when categoryId=4 and activityKind is 'assessment' or 'reflection'.

reason.description: Required when enabled is false, e.g. "missing_internal_target".
